races.paceDynamic: Amina will take the field along from the front as the only confirmed front runner, with In The Trenches likely to track her in second from his prominent style. The sustainable pace won't be pressured early, allowing the large field of hold-up horses to settle behind. This will create a tactical affair that builds into a sprint finish where positioning and stamina will be crucial. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, as they'll have the tactical advantage in what becomes a positioning battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Amina sets steady fractions and the field stays bunched until the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a positioning battle where horses with good acceleration benefit most. Hold-up horses with proven finishing speed can pick their way through and prominent trackers avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Amina goes too slow or gets headed early by prominent runners
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble with no clear tempo, suiting versatile horses who can adapt. Experienced campaigners with tactical speed can capitalize on the confusion.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If In The Trenches or other prominent runners press Amina from early
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina over the extended trip. This favours horses with proven staying power who can grind out the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Amina gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Her early advantage proves decisive as the field struggles to close the gap. Front runners with tactical speed can steal races when given too much rope.

Several lightly raced horses including Western Shores and Mydreamtell represent unknown quantities for powerful yards

races.paceDynamic: She's A Fine Wine will set the early pace from the front with minimal pressure, as most of this field comprises hold-up horses and mid-division runners. Long Gone, Hillhead Runner and Tir Og may track her in the outer positions, but none are confirmed pace pressers. The moderate gallop will allow the leaders to stay in touch turning for home, before the race develops into a sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs. This sustainable pace setup clearly favours prominent racers and those with early tactical speed who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop in the pack behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If She's A Fine Wine and Long Gone set a controlled tempo without serious pace pressure
scenarios.body: The even gallop allows prominent runners to stay within striking distance and kick clear in the straight while hold-up horses get caught in traffic. Early positioning proves decisive as the leaders have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Find Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final 3 furlongs creating gaps for closers
scenarios.body: Strong stayers like Hasten Slowly and Miss Manzor benefit from the slow early pace and find racing room to unleash their finishing kicks. The patient tactics pay dividends in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Compromise Works
scenarios.trigger: If runners like Radar Ahead and You Make Me Smile get perfect positions 4th-6th
scenarios.body: The mid-division horses avoid both pace pressure and traffic problems, allowing them to strike at the optimal moment. They benefit from cover early and clear runs late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If She's A Fine Wine goes too slow early and gets swamped by the entire field
scenarios.body: The front-runner sets such a pedestrian pace that even the slowest finishers can close the gap, creating a cavalry charge finish where stamina trumps speed.

races.paceDynamic: Chanceawetmorning will make the running from the front as the only natural leader, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure from fellow prominent runners Red Glory, Mr Master Mac, Cloonainra and Malbay Madness. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Arch Empire, Kamino Bello, Bridgehead and Dontgowithjoe will sit off the pace in the rear division. With minimal early pace pressure and one confirmed front-runner, this creates a tactical race where the pace will be steady rather than strong. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, while penalising those needing a strong gallop to show their best.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Red Glory or Mr Master Mac track Chanceawetmorning closely and outstay the leader
scenarios.body: The steady pace allows prominent runners to conserve energy before challenging, with their superior class telling in the final furlong. Red Glory's 231-day break becomes less relevant when he can sit handy and pounce.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and suits a strong closer with tactical speed
scenarios.body: Arch Empire or Kamino Bello benefit from the crawling gallop, allowing them to unleash their finishing kick from the back of the field. The lack of early pace sets up perfectly for horses that need to be produced late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Chanceawetmorning gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead allows the front-runner to dictate terms completely, building an unassailable advantage before the field can respond. His recent winning form suggests he can sustain the effort when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo becomes unsustainably slow and a rank outsider benefits from the sprint finish
scenarios.body: The crawling pace negates class differences and allows a horse like Metamorpheus with his recent second to steal the race with a well-timed challenge. Low-grade handicap form becomes more relevant in a tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Chanceawetmorning may get uncontested lead and prove difficult to peg back if allowed soft fractions throughout

Arch Empire and Kamino Bello need the pace to develop strongly to showcase their finishing kicks effectively
Several 7lb claiming jockeys aboard prominent chances may lack tactical experience in slowly-run handicap
Course winner Mr Master Mac has significant weight advantage and proven ability to handle Downpatrick's demands

races.paceDynamic: Beat The Devil is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The prominent runners Lumiere Du Large, Butch Coolidge, Maxwell Smart, Pure Logic and Annie's Angel will track the leader in the early stages, creating a decent-sized group within striking distance. The hold-up horses Fedneys Park, Houndsworth, Sea Of Doubt and Blue Moon Boy will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their late charges. With only one natural leader and several prominent runners likely to settle kindly, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses who can capitalize on a solid but not frantic gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Devil sets honest fractions without being pressured by the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The pace will be just strong enough to bring the closers into play, with the hold-up runners having too much finishing kick for the leaders. Sea Of Doubt and Houndsworth benefit most from this patient tactical approach.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack travel well and kick clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: Lumiere Du Large, Butch Coolidge and Maxwell Smart use their class advantage to pull clear of Beat The Devil, with the hold-up horses finding them gone. The good ground and sustainable pace suits their racing styles perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Beat The Devil wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader gets an uncontested lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: With his high rating of OR=120, Beat The Devil could prove tough to peg back if allowed to dictate completely unchallenged. His long absence becomes less relevant if he gets an armchair ride in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Devil goes too slowly and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure creates a messy finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win. This chaotic scenario particularly benefits horses with recent form and fitness advantages.

Maxwell Smart's fitness on return - the 57-day break could be either positive or negative depending on work at home

races.paceDynamic: Oh So Charming will set the pace unopposed with his proven front-running style, joined only by Walk Win, Demanding Gerry, Spanish John, Centaq and Georginas Jet in the prominent group. With 10 hold-up horses including High Notions, Victoria Kesia, Bowgate Street and multiple horses carrying fade warnings, the early gallop will be controlled and sustainable. Oh So Charming can dictate terms without pressure, setting up a tactical finish where the large hold-up contingent will struggle to close ground effectively. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, plus any hold-up horse with proven finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Oh So Charming sets uncontested fractions with Walk Win tracking
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can kick clear in the straight while prominent runners like Demanding Gerry and Centaq get first run on the field. Hold-up horses face a wall of traffic and insufficient pace collapse to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Quality Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If High Notions or Bowgate Street produce career-best finishing kicks despite tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: Class tells as the highest-rated hold-up horses overcome the pace scenario through superior ability. Their recent form and ratings edge compensates for poor positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Walk Win or Spanish John press Oh So Charming from halfway, creating genuine tempo
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and sets up closers while potentially finding out the leader's stamina reserves. Late-running horses get the pace collapse they need to be effective.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If Georginas Jet or Spanish John benefit from a perfectly-timed run through gaps
scenarios.body: Lower-rated prominent runners capitalize on the tactical setup while higher-rated horses encounter trouble or fade. The pace scenario creates the perfect storm for an upset.
